title: Innolight, China's leading maker of optical transceivers, closes 2% below its Hong Kong IPO price after raising ~$6.8B, the city's biggest listing since 2019 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Innolight, China's leading maker of optical transceivers, closes 2% below its Hong Kong IPO price after raising ~$6.8B, the city's biggest listing since 2019 — Zhongji Innolight Co. dropped in its Hong Kong trading debut after raising HK$53.4 billion ($6.8 billion) in the city's largest listing in seven years.
